details.description: StarCoderBase-7B is a 7-billion-parameter code-generation model from the BigCode project, trained on over 80 programming languages from The Stack (v1.2) using a GPT-2-style architecture with multi-query attention and a fill-in-the-middle objective over roughly 1 trillion tokens. Like the larger StarCoder models, it is a base model rather than an instruction-tuned assistant. BigCode's current model listing presents the newer StarCoder2 family as its successor generation.
advantages: Scores 28.37% pass@1 on HumanEval, per the model card.
Supports an 8,192-token context window and fill-in-the-middle completion, trained on over 80 programming languages, per the model card.
disadvantages: Superseded by the StarCoder2 family, which BigCode's model listing presents as its current generation of code models.
Not an instruction-following model; the model card says it works better as a technical assistant with appropriate prompting than with direct commands.
The model card warns it 'can generate source code verbatim from the dataset' and that generated code is not guaranteed to work as intended.
use_cases: Code completion and generation across 80+ programming languages

notes: This is BigCode's StarCoderBase-7B (bigcode/starcoderbase-7b on Hugging Face), matching the Fireworks host id 'starcoder-7b'.
